## Context
Execute ADLC v0.3 Modernization Wave 4 (Gate Promotion & Core Consolidation) and Wave 5 (Plugin Hook Codegen) per `.adlc/specs/adlc-wave4-wave5-plan.md`:
1. `W4-T1` + `W4-T5`: Promote process identity & lock probes (`thisHost`, `pidAlive`, `procStartTimeOf`, `selfProcessIdentity`, `defaultLockProbes`) to `@adlc/core` and delegate `packages/fleet/lib/proc.mjs` and `packages/autopilot/lib/lock.mjs`.
2. `W4-T2`: Promote diff-scoped fast test target and mutant budget planner from `scripts/mutation-gate.mjs` to `packages/hollow-test/lib/gate-plan.mjs`.
3. `W4-T3`: Consolidate `packages/decision-layer/lib/canonical.mjs` canonical JSON and SHA-256 hashing onto `@adlc/core`.
4. `W4-T4`: Promote ADR 0014 findings-ledger git-boundary scanner and append-only guard to `packages/lesson-foundry/lib/ledger-guard.mjs`.
5. `W5-T1` + `W5-T2` + `W5-T3`: Canonicalize `@adlc/core` trusted-binary resolver, extend `scripts/ticket-readers/generate.mjs` to emit `generated-shell.mjs`, `generated-risk-tier.mjs`, and `generated-trusted-binary.mjs`, and eliminate ~950 LOC of hand-inlined `KEEP IN SYNC` copies across `adlc-claude-code`, `adlc-codex`, and `adlc-copilot` hooks.

## Acceptance Criteria
- All 8 acceptance criteria in `.adlc/specs/adlc-wave4-wave5-plan.md` pass.
- Verify: `node scripts/ticket-readers/generate.mjs --check && node --test packages/core/test/proc.test.mjs packages/core/test/core.test.mjs packages/core/test/trusted-binary.test.mjs packages/core/test/shell.test.mjs packages/core/test/risk-tier.test.mjs packages/hollow-test/test/gate-plan.test.mjs scripts/test/mutation-gate.test.mjs packages/decision-layer/test/canonical.test.mjs packages/lesson-foundry/test/ledger-guard.test.mjs packages/fleet/test/lock-recovery.test.mjs packages/autopilot/test/lock.test.mjs scripts/test/ticket-reader-generation.test.mjs`
title: refactor(adlc): Wave 4 & Wave 5 core process/planner/ledger consolidation and plugin hook codegen
